head: Local Skies shows the weather like a classic TV forecast
dek: Local Skies brings the look of old TV weather reports to the iPhone, cycling through the forecast with a ticker at the bottom. It was #13 among paid Weather apps on the US App Store on 3 November.
details: It has current conditions, hourly and five-day forecasts, animated radar, severe weather alerts on the ticker and optional background music, for US cities. It costs $2.99, by developer Aram Ormanian.
where: iPhone and iPad, App Store, $2.99; US cities
means: If you miss the local TV forecast, it gives you that look on your phone.
todo: Find Local Skies in the App Store; it covers US cities.
